title: SKU and tiered limits launch orchestration for pricing and billing transition
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Coordination ticket to orchestrate the launch of the new SKU structure and tiered usage limits across Hosted and Dedicated products. Goals: (1) finalize SKU mappings and naming, (2) implement migration/proration rules for existing customers, (3) confirm billing pipeline and ledger reconciliation, (4) publish release notes and support + sales enablement materials, (5) update Console UI and admin tooling for limit enforcement and overrides. This ticket coordinates engineering rollout, finance sign-off, legal review of T&Cs, and CS/sales communications.
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with Eng, Finance, Legal, Support, Growth attended. Agreed scope: two new SKUs (Standard/Pro), usage limit tiers (S/M/L), and optional overage billing with cap. Action owners assigned.
2026-02-18: SKU naming options reviewed. Finalized consumer-facing names: 'Redwood Standard' and 'Redwood Pro'. Internal codes: RWD-STD, RWD-PRO. Design to produce UI copy by 2026-02-24 (DES-334).

2026-02-25: Finance provided migration rules draft: 30-day grandfather window for existing customers, prorated credits applied on subscription change. Created spreadsheet for proration scenarios: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q2PRICINGEXAMPLE

2026-03-02: Eng landed billing integration spike and prototype webhook consumer (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/1234). Noted risk: legacy invoices lacking line-item IDs—FIN-212 opened.
2026-03-05: Legal requested updated TOS snippets to include new overage caps and billing cycles. Draft uploaded to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/PRICING-REDESIGN
2026-03-08: Support runbook draft completed. Includes troubleshooting steps for failed migrations and rollback plan. Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Support-Runbooks-PRM
2026-03-11: Sales enablement playbook first draft in Drive (slides, pricing calculator, objection handling). Feedback from SalesOps scheduled 2026-03-14.

2026-03-13: End-to-end staging test passed for single-tenant migration path. Canary plan documented; initial canary target: 5 mid-market customers (Ops ticket ENG-4120). Next: expand canary to 50 customers and monitor billing reconciliation dashboard.

2026-03-13: Action items: (a) Eng to add analytics events for old_sku->new_sku migration, (b) Finance to sign off reconciliation for proration test case ID PR-07, (c) PM to finalize release notes copy and coordinate scheduled broadcast email template.
acceptance_criteria: SKU names and internal codes approved by Product, Finance, and Legal
Migration/proration logic implemented and unit-tested with edge cases (partial-period subscriptions, refunds)
Billing pipeline handles SKU change webhooks and produces reconciled ledger entries in staging
Console UI exposes new SKU selector and limit tiers; admin override feature available for Support
Customer-facing release notes and billing comms approved and scheduled
Sales enablement materials (slides, price calculator, FAQ) published to Drive and linked in Sales Hub
Canary rollout plan executed and reconciled for initial cohort with no unresolved invoice mismatches
risks: Invoice reconciliation gap for legacy customers due to missing line-item metadata
Customer confusion leading to increased support volume if release notes and emails are unclear
Legal delay on TOS updates could require postponing overage enforcement
Edge cases in proration causing revenue leakage if not validated across billing cycles and currencies
